claims.text: Rosewood Cape Kidnappers is in Hawke's Bay, New Zealand.

findings.quote: Rosewood Cape KidnappersHawke's Bay, New Zealand

claims.text: The golf course was designed by Tom Doak.

findings.quote: the Tom Doak–designed course is legendary

claims.text: Vegetables, fruits and herbs harvested from the property's own garden shape the seasonal cuisine.

findings.quote: The lush vegetables, fruits and herbs that are harvested from Rosewood Cape Kidnapper’s own garden, shape the seasonal cuisine

claims.text: The Dining Room's menu highlights local seasonal produce and changes daily.

findings.quote: Featuring menus that highlight local seasonal produce through delightful flavour combinations in a menu that changes daily.

claims.text: Guests can also dine at the golf course clubhouse, which has a more casual menu.

findings.quote: guests can dine at the clubhouse on the golf course with a more casual menu

claims.text: Rooms are minimalist country-house chic, with lofted ceilings, timber trusses, off-white shiplap and barn doors.

findings.quote: The rooms are minimalist country-house chic: lofted ceilings with timber trusses, off-white shiplap, and barn doors.

claims.text: Rooms have deep soaking tubs in front of picture windows overlooking the sea.

findings.quote: Deep soaking tubs sit in front of picture windows overlooking the sea

claims.text: Grand Ridge Junior Suites sit on a skyline ridge with views over the farm and the Pacific Ocean.

findings.quote: Set on a skyline ridge with stunning views over the farm and the Pacific Ocean

claims.text: Cape Sanctuary night tours introduce guests to New Zealand's nocturnal wildlife.

findings.quote: Experience the magic of Cape Sanctuary's night tour for an unforgettable journey into New Zealand's nocturnal wonders.
this is one of the best places on mainland New Zealand for native wildlife, notably birds, including kiwis. Both daytime and nighttime tours

claims.text: Complimentary activities change day to day and include flower-arranging classes, foraging workshops and farm tours.

findings.quote: Complimentary activities change day to day and include options like flower-arranging classes, foraging workshops, and farm tours.

claims.text: Winery tours visit Hawke's Bay vineyards and wineries, and a Can-Am tour explores the property with an experienced local.

findings.quote: Take an unforgettable journey through the vineyards and wineries that make Hawke's Bay a Great Wine Capital of the World.
Explore the rugged beauty of Cape Kidnappers with an experienced local aboard a Can-Am

claims.text: Spa treatment rooms are in a building just above the main lodge, with a terrace for tea after treatments.

findings.quote: Quiet treatment rooms perfect for pampering line a hallway in a building just above the main lodge. Following your massage, sit on the terrace with a cup of tea.

claims.text: The hotel describes its gannet colony as the largest, most accessible mainland colony of gannets in the world.

findings.quote: the largest, most accessible mainland colony of gannets in the world

claims.text: The property is a 6,000-acre working sheep and beef farm, where guests can join the farmer and his trained farm dogs for a shepherding experience.

findings.quote: Join our farmer and his highly trained farm dogs for an introduction to life on a 6,000 acre working sheep and beef farm

claims.text: Daytime and nighttime tours of Cape Sanctuary are offered exclusively to Cape Kidnappers guests.

findings.quote: Both daytime and nighttime tours are offered exclusively to Cape Kidnappers guests.

claims.text: The clifftop golf course, completed in 2004, sits in a ridge-and-valley landscape with sea views.

findings.quote: Celebrated as a modern marvel since its completion in 2004, this remarkable clifftop New Zealand course is nestled in a ridge-and-valley landscape with arresting sea views.

claims.text: Nature's Dining Room is a gourmet picnic hamper of local food and wine to enjoy out in the landscape.

findings.quote: Experience the spectacular natural landscape with a gourmet picnic hamper filled with a curated selection of local food and wine.

claims.text: There is no kids club; families can instead watch sheepdogs at work, go hiking and encounter native birds.

findings.quote: don't expect a kids club. Instead, families can watch sheepdogs at work, go hiking, and meet encounter native birds throughout the property.

claims.text: Guests typically fly into the small regional airport at Napier, then drive along the coast and up into the hills.

findings.quote: Fly into the little regional airport at Napier, drive through the city's Art Deco downtown, and continue along the coast and up into the hills

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires significant travel planning.
